title: Game Theory
intro: The study of strategic decision-making among rational agents.

blocks.text: This topic is a short starter: its pages are stubs waiting to be written out.

items: Nash Equilibrium (#/math/game-theory/nash-equilibrium): A strategy profile where no player can gain by unilaterally changing their own strategy.
Dominant Strategies (#/math/game-theory/dominant-strategies): Strategies that yield a better outcome for a player regardless of what the others do.
Prisoner's Dilemma (#/math/game-theory/prisoners-dilemma): The classic game showing why two rational agents may fail to cooperate even when it serves them both.
